entries.63bc052f69e27b5d: The company positions itself as a mid-sized shipyard whose technological capabilities are highly regarded in Japan and overseas, and it has ship types such as small and medium-sized ferries and RORO ships, with a wealth of construction track record. Leveraging its two-plant structure in Setoda and Innoshima, it works to improve productivity through the continuous construction of vessels of the same type. Under the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism’s energy-saving rating system for coastal ships, 23 ships it built have received the highest rating.
entries.6478c2adfd32ca31: This is a reportable segment in which the company builds and repairs ships, and the consolidated subsidiary Naikai Engineering Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells abrasive materials and repairs life rafts. The company carries out construction and repair work at two plants, the Setoda Plant and the Innoshima Plant. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥46,497 million.

entries.aa8b00fc0a1fa150: In the newbuilding business, the company says it will promote a product mix of ocean-going ships, such as general cargo ships and car carriers, and coastal ships, such as ferries and RORO ships, and build a wide variety of ship types, from Panamax-size medium-sized ships to small ferries. It also sets out strengthening cost competitiveness and thorough risk management through an integrated order system (sales, design, procurement and production operations), and expanding its business and reducing costs through strategic capital investment in its two plants. In the refit business, it cites improving customer satisfaction through prompt and flexible response, and high-quality repairs based on technology and know-how. For the fiscal year ending March 2027, it says it will work to improve productivity, among other measures, with the aim of achieving its consolidated revenue forecast of ¥46 billion.
